config.label: Absolute path to a custom memory storage directory
config.description: Absolute path to a custom memory storage directory. Overrides the default per-project location.

config.label: Set to 'global' to store memories in ~/
config.description: Set to 'global' to store memories in ~/.agent-memory/ instead of the per-project default ./.agent-memory/.

config.label: Log level: debug | info | warn | error
config.description: Log level: debug | info | warn | error. Defaults to info. Logs go to stderr (won't pollute MCP stdio).
